full_judgment: 2. The petitioner filed the suit for partition stating, inter alia, that the land measuring .38 acres appertaining to C.S. Khatian No. 328 and plot No. 1399 originally belonged to one Mohendra Nath Sannyal who settled the same to Kanchan Bewa. At the time of S.A. operation the same was recorded in the name of Kanchan Bewa in Khatian No. 345. Kanchan Bewa sold .05 acre of land to petitioner by kabala deed dated 25.01.1965. Earlier Kanchan had two daughters namely Parbati and Bahaton by her previous husbands. After the death of Kanchan Bewa her husband Ismail Sheikh inherited ¼ th share of the said land measuring an area of .081/4% acre, Bahaton and Parbati inherited the rest. Thereafter Ismail died leaving behind the petitioner as his only son who inherited the said .081/4% acre of land. By this way the petitioner  acquired title in respect of .141/4% acre of land. The petitioner requested the defendant No.9 to make partition of the suit land on 2.2.1993 but he denied. Hence, the suit.
